settings.text: The automatic dual-outlet gas filling machine is easy to operate and enables standard gas filling of two glass units simultaneously. Its distinctive specifications and features ensure a long service life. This article introduces the automatic gas filling machine and outlines its technical specifications.

settings.title: Brief Introduction to the Automatic Dual-Channel Gas Filling Machine
settings.text:
Argon is classified among the noble gases in the periodic table and does not naturally form compounds. It is an inert gas that does not undergo chemical reactions under normal conditions, making it one of the most suitable gases for filling the space between two panes of glass.
Argon is separated from liquefied gases through distillation using specialized equipment, then introduced between double- or triple-glazed panes. The importance of argon and its use between glass panes have led manufacturers to develop suitable machines for filling this gas. Gas filling machines are produced in automatic and manual versions, with automatic models available in several categories.
Among automatic filling machines, capacity is an important factor. The automatic dual-outlet gas filling machine is considered a high-capacity option because it can fill two glass units with gas simultaneously.
Its lightweight design and simple operation make it a trusted choice for many professionals. It can achieve a gas filling rate of over 99% between the glass panes.

settings.title: Technical Specifications of the Automatic Dual-Outlet Gas Filling Machine
settings.text:
Because the gas filling machine is an important piece of equipment, it must be manufactured with a high-quality body to prevent damage to its sensitive components during transportation and handling.

All external parts are coated using an electrostatic powder-coating and oven-curing process. This protects the body from damage when exposed to water and moisture.
First-grade, standard components are also used throughout the machine to prevent damage to its internal parts over long periods of operation.
The machine is approximately 50 cm long, 43 cm wide and 20 cm high, making it easy to move and transport.
It weighs approximately 12 kg, so a single operator can move it.
The machine is equipped with a responsive touchscreen through which all functions can be controlled.

settings.title: How Argon Gas Is Filled Using the Automatic Dual-Outlet Machine
settings.text:
To operate the automatic dual-outlet gas filling machine, certain accessories and supplies are required. Once an argon cylinder with 99.99% purity and a mains electricity connection are available, the machine can be connected and switched on to begin filling the space between the glass panes.
Connect the pneumatic hose from the pressure regulator outlet to the machine inlet, then press the power switch on the back of the machine to start the process.
First, enter the glass width, length and thickness on the touchscreen in the designated fields. The machine will calculate the required gas volume.
Then press Start on the touchscreen or use the start push button on the machine to begin the operation.
Gas filling will start, and the machine's buzzer will sound when the process is complete. Automatic shut-off is also available.

settings.title: Unique Features of the Automatic Dual-Outlet Gas Filling Machine
settings.text:
Among the wide range of gas filling machines currently available on the market, some offer distinct capabilities that make them particularly useful to operators.
The automatic dual-outlet gas filling machine attracts particular attention because it can fill two glass units of different dimensions simultaneously.
Overall, this machine offers several specialized capabilities that make it a preferred option for many industrial operators.
Its distinctive features include the following:
It can be used with various systems, including warm-edge spacers, polysulfide, hot-melt and manual methods.
The machine includes intelligent gas-filling calculation software. Once the operator enters the glass dimensions, including length and thickness, the system adjusts the required gas volume.
It supports different software programs to help ensure operator safety throughout the gas filling process.
An automatic shut-off sensor stops the machine when filling is complete, including when the operator is not present.
The machine is easy to operate, and even a semi-skilled operator can use it to achieve high-quality results.
The machine can also operate with two glass units of different dimensions at the same time.

settings.title: Advantages of Using the Automatic Dual-Outlet Gas Filling Machine
settings.text:
As mentioned earlier, gas filling is a practical method for introducing argon gas between the panes of different types of double-glazed units.
Among the available options, the automatic dual-outlet gas filling machine offers several advantages. It also allows the gas level inside double-glazed units to be tested, so you can check the quality with confidence after the process is complete.
The machine uses a pump to extract air from the glass unit before injecting gas, and a sensor stops the gas supply once filling is complete. These features help introduce argon effectively into the space between the panes.
One of its key benefits is a three-star Gold Warranty valid for 18 months, reflecting the quality of the components and parts used in the product.
In addition, after-sales service and spare-parts supply are available for 360 months, allowing you to use the machine with confidence and resolve any issue in less time.
